unmapped.reason: keyword exclusion is not an MCP filter
unmapped.fallback: exclude_keyword_tags: /source lists the pool's companies with this Apollo keyword tag (free apollo_organizations_lookup) and marks them skipped_prefilter

handled.note: Net New: /source keeps only the `organizations` (net-new) bucket

notes: EXAMPLE values for the fictional sample company (regional grocery chains). scripts/apollo_url.py resolve refuses to run while source_url starts with EXAMPLE.
The keyword-tag exclusion is applied via exclude_keyword_tags, not by the search itself.

pre_filter._notes: Client-side, applied by scripts/source_queue.py select. Unknown values never exclude. Prefiltered companies are still registered in Apollo (status skipped_prefilter) so they never resurface. Keep the regexes conservative: an excluded company is gone for good. exclude_subsidiaries skips rows that carry a parent company (CSV imports only).
